text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 infusion treatment refers to the intravenous administration of medications, specifically monoclonal antibodies, to help the body fight off the virus. These man-made antibodies are designed to mimic those produced by the body after recovery from COVID-19 and can reduce the viral load, potentially preventing severe illness and hospitalization. The treatment is typically given as a single intravenous dose, followed by a period of observation.
